patthana15.54:1.1: Nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nabhāvanāya pahātabbo nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana15.54:2.1: Bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nabhāvanāya pahātabbo naakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā dve.
patthana15.54:3.1: Nabhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā nanabhāvanāya pahātabbo naabyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā dve.
